evals.name: stream-probe
evals.prompt: Run a direct diagnostic against /api/features/authors/listing/all-authors while I register Aster.
evals.expected_output: Inspect two SSE results without reconnecting.
assertions: Pipes the direct query to check-frames.mjs.
Waits for the first ready result before registration and checks for a second.

evals.name: missing-frame
evals.prompt: The direct author query stays connected but never emits the new author. Where do I look?
evals.expected_output: Separate projection failure from notification failure.
assertions: After successful RegisterAuthor, inspects the authors collection in library (or library+<tenantId>) and checks the stored _id.

evals.name: browser-only
evals.prompt: Curl gets the second author list, but the browser does not. Diagnose the next boundary.
evals.expected_output: Check hub delivery before the component.
assertions: Checks UseWebSockets before UseCratis for WebSockets.
Checks the expected author ID in the browser delivery before editing React.
